data.title: 春日野穹 · 石阶上安稳的一小步
data.description: 树荫下的神社石阶，穹穿蓝灰背带裙，坐下来重新扣紧鞋搭扣。兔子玩偶靠在身旁的布包上，她回头看了一眼阶上的树影，确认鞋子稳妥后，轻轻拍掉裙摆上的小叶子。
data.action: 坐在石阶上扣好鞋搭扣，轻拍掉裙角的落叶。
data.promptProse: Sora Kasugano sits on the shaded shrine steps, fastening the strap of her dark Mary Jane shoe beneath a slate-blue pinafore and white blouse. The rabbit plush rests against her cloth bag. After checking the buckle, she brushes a small leaf from her skirt and glances back at the trees. Reflected shade light reveals her white socks and buckle in the medium view, with layered step shadows and leaf silhouettes behind.
